title: Policy budgets (kind schema v1)
description: Owner: WS-03. Behavioral budget policy (ADR-013: budgets are in the bundle). Defines job and per-role run budgets in USD, the soft-limit fraction, the budget_extension gate parameters, and the tenant's gateway model allowlist. Tenant SPEND QUOTAS (month-to-date caps, daily caps) are operational configuration in tenancy (read live by the gateway shim), not here. A tenant-layer budgets policy may only tighten the base (ADR-013 tightening check: every number <= base, allowlist subset of base).

extension.description: budget_extension gate (C-MSG gate kind). Opened by the workflow when a run fails with GatewayBudgetExceeded or the job budget is exhausted while work remains.

maxIncreaseFraction.description: Each approved extension raises the job budget by at most this fraction of the original job budget.

approverGroups.description: Okta groups eligible to approve (in addition to gate_rules). The requester may approve only if gate_rules allows requester_may_decide.

requesterSelfApproveMaxUsd.description: Largest single extension the job's requester may approve themselves (control-review G-07). Default and recommended 0: the budget_extension gate is opened with requester_may_decide=false, so another eligible approver must decide. Tenant layers may only lower it.

maxExtensionsPerJob.description: Hard cap on approved extensions per job, across all approvers.

gatewayAccess.description: Tenant model allowlist (brief: model allowlists per tenant). Bundle build fails if any agent reachable for the tenant uses a model outside allow. At runtime the gateway shim enforces the run token's models claim (CCR-03-01), which the Runner derives from the agent definition and this policy.

dataClassificationCeiling.description: Highest repository data classification (WS-09 vocabulary) whose code may be sent to the models in allow. Router/risk rules refuse jobs above it.

workerLlm.description: Budget for in-worker LLM calls (router, triage, extraction) charged to the job.

embeddings.description: Embedding spend through the gateway (R2-057). memory-service calls the gateway's embeddings route as a service caller with purpose=embedding; the shim enforces perTenantDayUsd per tenant per UTC day and the backfill job enforces reembedBackfillUsdMax per re-embedding run (and the shim enforces it as a pipeline counter when the job passes X-Replicant-Pipeline-Id).

models.description: Allowed embedding model IDs (gateway model IDs).

prLifetimeUsd.description: Ceiling on cumulative spend (LLM + worker LLM + compute) across all jobs on one pull request, read by control-plane-api intake from cost.v_pr_spend before starting another job on that PR (XD-FIX-R2-059, R1V-116). Tenant layers may only lower it. Default 300.

repairCycleUsd.description: Additional budget granted to each PR repair cycle (D-15), on top of what remains.

reservePerRunUsd.description: Amount held back from the job budget for each still-unstarted mandatory node (QA, reviewer) when computing an implementer run budget, so that the implementer cannot consume the whole job budget.

jobBaseUsd.description: Base job allowance before extensions and repair-cycle grants (renamed from jobUsd, R2-060).

jobHardCapUsd.description: Absolute ceiling on total job spend including extensions and repair cycles (R2-060). Effective job cap = min(JobRequest.constraints.budget_usd_max, jobHardCapUsd, jobBaseUsd + approved extensions + cycles × repairCycleUsd).
